name: ForestTurkey
visual_note: Viewed six images: final runtime_r01/four_directions.png, runtime_visual_strip.png, existing playback_review_r01.png, and three new summaries composed from native GIF phases. The turkey has a round ochre-brown spotted belly, a pale gold long neck and wattle, and a five-feather rounded fan with gold bands and pale taupe tips. The front shows two eyes and a beak; the back shows only the back of the head and neck, with the centered tail fan covering much of the torso. Folded wings join both sides and two thin legs remain attached below the belly; no detached or duplicated limbs are visible. Up/Down native phase samples show alternating foot positions and a small body bob; turning samples retain the original side-view stride, and no ground shadow is visible in the inspected directions or action samples. Attack samples show angry front eyes followed by the normal face; hurt flashes white then recovers. The two death sequences show front/back sideward collapse, shrinking and progressive fade, followed by reuse with the normal front face and opaque body restored. Pause/speed samples retain the rear fan and connected legs. This was a six-summary-image visual review, not a new Play run or an exhaustive frame-by-frame review; pause/speed timing and same-instance reuse are separately supported by the existing two 84-check runtime reports. User art approval remains pending.
method: Six summary images; last three compose selected native GIF phases without synthetic poses. No additional Play run. Timing assertions are separate from visual observations.
